user.title: Step 1: Thermostats and Zones Setup
user.description: Set the heating system name, the number of thermal zones, thermostat hysteresis, and automatic Day/Night schedule.

data_description.system_name: Display name for the heating device in Home Assistant.
data_description.zone_count: How many independent zones or floors (zone valves) you want to control.
data_description.hysteresis: Temperature tolerance in °C before turning heating on or off (default 0.3 °C).
data_description.schedule_enabled: If enabled, you will configure Day and Night start times in the next step.

schedule_hours.title: Step 1b: Day / Night Schedule Hours
schedule_hours.description: Set the start times for the Day and Night temperature presets.

data_description.day_start_time: Time when all active zone thermostats automatically switch to the Day preset.
data_description.night_start_time: Time when all active zone thermostats automatically switch to the Night preset.

zone.title: Step 2: Zone Thermostat {zone_num} of {zone_total}
zone.description: Configure the zone valve switch, room temperature sensor, and target temperatures for the 3 presets.

data_description.zone_name: E.g. Floor 1, Floor 2, Living Area, or Sleeping Area.
data_description.valve_entity: The switch entity that opens and closes the motorized valve for this zone.
data_description.temp_sensor: The temperature sensor measuring the room temperature for this zone.
data_description.temp_day: Target temperature when the Day preset is active.
data_description.temp_night: Target temperature when the Night preset is active.
data_description.temp_away: Reduced target temperature when Away mode is active.

heater_and_safety.title: Advanced Settings — 1. Heat Generator & Dissipation
heater_and_safety.description: Configure the common heat generator switch, exclusive switch control, and residual heat dissipation.

data_description.heater_entity: Select the dry-contact / relay switch that turns the main heat generator on and off.
data_description.exclusive_control: If enabled, hides physical switches in Home Assistant and immediately reverts manual state changes.
data_description.cooldown_enabled: If enabled, keeps a zone valve open after generator shutdown to dissipate residual heat.

cooldown.title: Advanced Settings — 2. Heat Dissipation
cooldown.description: Select the zone valve to keep open during cooldown, whether to monitor generator power in Watts, and the closing timer.

data.use_power_sensor: Use Watt monitoring sensor to detect generator operating state

data_description.cooldown_zone_id: Which zone valve to keep open after shutdown so residual hot water can circulate safely.
data_description.use_power_sensor: If enabled, uses a power sensor (Watts) to close the valve as soon as the generator finishes shutting down.
data_description.cooldown_minutes: Valve opening duration in minutes (used as a safety fallback if Watt monitoring is enabled).

power_sensor.title: Advanced Settings — 2.1 Watt Monitoring
power_sensor.description: Configure the power sensor and Watt threshold used to determine when the heat generator is active.

data_description.power_sensor: Select the Watt sensor (e.g. smart plug) measuring the electrical power draw of the heat generator.
data_description.power_threshold_watt: Above this threshold (Watts) the generator is considered active; below this threshold it is considered off.
data_description.power_grace_seconds: Initial wait time in seconds after shutdown before checking Watts, to ignore sensor reporting delays.

manual_safety.title: Advanced Settings — 3. Manual Ignition Detection
manual_safety.description: Automatically detects via the Watt sensor if the heat generator is turned on manually while thermostats are off.

data.use_separate_manual_zone: Use a different zone valve for manual ignition

data_description.manual_safety_enabled: If power draw exceeds the Watt threshold while thermostats are idle, automatically opens a safety valve.
data_description.use_separate_manual_zone: If disabled, uses the same valve as heat dissipation; if enabled, lets you choose a dedicated valve in the next step.

manual_zone.title: Advanced Settings — 3.1 Manual Ignition Safety Valve
manual_zone.description: Select which zone valve to open when manual ignition of the heat generator is detected.

data_description.manual_safety_zone_id: Which zone valve to open automatically when generator power exceeds the Watt threshold while thermostats are off.
